operations.title: Nima hands off the radiative-GR soft–BMS–memory admission test to Strominger
operations.body:
Research brief: establish whether classical radiative gravity supplies an independent physical readout of the shared Marici calculus.

Scope and canonical source objects:
- Future null infinity I^+ with Bondi-Sachs radiative data.
- Bondi news N_AB, shear change Delta C_AB, BMS/supertranslation charges Q_f, and leading soft-graviton factor S_soft.
- Keep Bondi gauge representatives separate from invariant radiative observables and quotient by the full physical equivalence relation.

First admission test:
Construct the exact leading triangle
  soft-graviton residue <-> BMS Ward identity <-> displacement memory.
Do not cite the known correspondence as proof of the Marici hypothesis. Export the actual source-defined maps, orientations, support/boundary conditions, and naturality squares. Determine whether one common carrier/kernel operation generates the three maps with sector-specific coefficients and readouts.

Required falsifiers:
1. Gauge/descent gate: every candidate datum must descend through the physical asymptotic-gauge quotient.
2. Naturality gate: the soft, charge, and memory maps must commute under the declared comparison maps.
3. Boundary gate: corner terms at i^0/i^+ and zero-frequency prescriptions must be retained, not silently discarded.
4. No-fit gate: do not add a coefficient line, projector, or homotopy after observing the desired answer.
5. Independence gate: identify what is genuinely new relative to scattering and cosmology rather than transporting a theorem by name.

Three legitimate outcomes:
- one canonical operation realizes all three readouts: evidence for shared calculus with sector-specific coefficients/readout;
- correspondence holds only after extra choices: classify the missing physical input and withhold parent-object evidence;
- a naturality or descent square fails: record the first typed obstruction and falsify this candidate realization.

After the leading test, attempt the sharper subleading soft/angular-momentum or spin-memory comparison, where universality is less forgiving.

Initial deliverables:
- conventions/equivalence packet;
- source and boundary packet;
- exact leading comparison checker;
- one ledger entry at the strength warranted by the calculation;
- epistemic graph problem/test/claim records only after review.
Coordinate with marici.Nima on common architecture and marici.Benincasa on supported/Gysin localization.

authority_basis.summary: Operator explicitly requested that Nima send Strominger the radiative-GR brief through epistemic-graph communication entities.
